title: MazeRunners
description: Maze Runners is a competitive Minecraft Fabric mod that turns procedurally generated mazes into a full tournament-style minigame.
body:
Maze Runners is a competitive Minecraft Fabric mod that turns procedurally generated mazes into a full tournament-style minigame.

Players race through large mazes filled with traps, effects, and tactical items while a global timer tracks performance across multiple tournament stages.

Perfect for events, livestreams, and competitive servers.

**Features**

 Procedural Maze Generation

 Tournament System (32 → 16 → 8 → 4)

 Global Tournament Timer (Bossbar)
 Best-Time Tracking & Leaderboard
 Player GUI Menu
 Advanced Spectator Mode
 Strategic Traps (Carpets)
 Teleport Swap Item
 Custom Maze Center Placement
 Admin-Controlled Flow (no automation chaos)

**General**
/maze menu
Open the Maze GUI

/maze join
Join the event (if open)

/maze leave
Leave the event

**Event Control**
/maze event open
Allow players to join

/maze event close
Close joining

**Maze Center**

/maze center here
Set maze center to your position

/maze center set <x y z>
Set maze center manually

/maze center get
Show current center

/maze center clear
Remove center

Maze Generation (Testing / Freebuild)
/maze generate <width> <height>
/maze generate <width> <height> <wall> <floor>
/maze generate <width> <height> <wall> <floor> <seed> <corridor>

**Spectator Mode**
/maze spectate
Enter spectator mode

/maze spectate stage <32|16|8|4>
Spectate a specific stage

/maze spectate follow <player>
Follow a player

/maze spectate unfollow
Stop following

/maze spectate rotate <on|off>
Enable / disable camera rotation

Tournament Commands

/maze tournament prepare
Prepare tournament (random seed)

/maze tournament prepare <seed>
Prepare tournament with fixed seed

/maze tournament start <32|16|8|4>
Start a tournament stage

/maze tournament stop
Stop the tournament

/maze tournament status
Show tournament status

/maze tournament resetstats
Reset timer & leaderboard (manual only)

**Recommended Flow (Admin)**
/maze center here
/maze event open
/maze tournament prepare
/maze tournament start 32
/maze tournament start 16
/maze tournament start 8
/maze tournament start 4
/maze tournament resetstats

Summary

Maze Runners is designed for:

Competitive servers

Event nights

Streamer challenges

Community tournaments

It gives full control to admins while keeping gameplay fair, intense, and fun.
